verdict.rationale: Spline's pricing page lists a "Team Library", and its components keep all instances in sync with the main component. That is a first-party shared-library capability, but the evidence shows reuse only within a single scene, not publishing across files or projects. Missing for 10: documented publishing of components and styles from a library across files and projects, controlled or accept-on-demand updates when the source changes, shared styles (colour/text/material tokens), Team Library documentation beyond a pricing bullet, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, shared libraries publish components and styles across files and projects, with controlled updates when the source changes

citations.quote: Components are objects that can be reused multiple times throughout your scene and whenever there are changes made to the main component all instances will update accordingly.
